import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-subset-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":46,"var":"data,size","code":"hb_blob_t *blob = hb_blob_create ((const char *)data, size, HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, NULL, NULL);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as the font blob that the subsetter will parse."},
{"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-subset-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":47,"var":"blob","code":"hb_face_t *face = hb_face_create (blob, 0);","note":"The blob becomes a HarfBuzz face, making the input font available to subsetting code."},
{"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-subset-fuzzer.cc","function":"trySubset","line":15,"var":"input->unicodes","code":"hb_set_t *codepoints = hb_subset_input_unicode_set (input);","note":"The fuzzer populates the subset request with attacker-chosen codepoints."},
{"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-subset-fuzzer.cc","function":"trySubset","line":19,"var":"text[i]","code":"hb_set_add (codepoints, text[i]);","note":"Each requested codepoint is added to the subset input, driving glyph selection from the font."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/hb-subset-plan.cc","function":"hb_subset_plan_create","line":84,"var":"cp","code":"while (unicodes->next (&cp)) { ... cmap.get_nominal_glyph (cp, &gid); ... initial_gids_to_retain->add (gid); }","note":"Requested codepoints are mapped through cmap to original glyph IDs that must be retained."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/hb-subset-plan.cc","function":"_populate_gids_to_retain","line":104,"var":"glyphs","code":"while (initial_gids_to_retain->next (&gid)) { _add_gid_and_children (glyf, gid, all_gids_to_retain); }","note":"Composite glyph dependencies are recursively added, expanding the retained glyph set."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/hb-subset-plan.cc","function":"_create_old_gid_to_new_gid_map","line":129,"var":"glyph_map","code":"glyph_map->set (glyphs[i], i);","note":"The retained glyph list is converted into a dense old-gid to new-gid mapping used during serialization."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/hb-subset-glyf.cc","function":"_update_components","line":133,"var":"iterator.current->glyphIndex","code":"if (!plan->new_gid_for_old_gid (iterator.current->glyphIndex, &new_gid)) continue;","note":"Composite glyph component references are rewritten using the subset glyph map."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/hb-ot-cmap-table.hh","function":"CmapSubtableFormat4::serialize","line":145,"var":"cp","code":"for (unsigned int j = 0; j < num_codepoints; j++) { hb_codepoint_t cp = segments[i].start_code + j; ... plan->new_gid_for_codepoint (cp, &new_gid); glyph_id_array[j].set (new_gid); }","note":"The subset cmap is serialized from the requested codepoints and their remapped glyph IDs."},
{"step":10,"file":"src/hb-ot-cmap-table.hh","function":"CmapSubtableFormat4::serialize","line":148,"var":"new_gid","code":"if (unlikely (!plan->new_gid_for_codepoint (cp, &new_gid))) return_trace (false);","note":"The vulnerable path depends on the remapped glyph IDs being looked up while building the output cmap."},
{"step":11,"file":"src/hb-subset.cc","function":"_subset","line":88,"var":"table->subset(plan)","code":"result = table->subset(plan);","note":"The subset pipeline serializes each retained table, including cmap and glyf, into the destination face."},
{"step":12,"file":"src/hb-subset-glyf.cc","function":"_write_glyf_and_loca_prime","line":171,"var":"glyf_prime_data_next","code":"memcpy (glyf_prime_data_next, glyf_data + start_offset, length);","note":"Glyph bytes are copied from the source font into the subset buffer; the crash is triggered later when malformed glyph data causes an out-of-bounds read in the vulnerable target."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path)
